projects.name: Delta Forge 2
projects.quote: As previously announced on June 8, 2026, signed a 210 MW, 15-year lease at Delta Forge 2 with the Company’s tier-one investment grade hyperscaler customer, representing approximately $5.2 billion of base-term contracted revenue.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 1 Building 1
projects.quote: The first 100 MW building at Polaris Forge 1 became operational in October 2025.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 1 Building 2
projects.quote: Building 2 (150 MW) was delivered in two 75 MW phases, the first on July 1, 2026 and the second on October 1 subsequent to quarter end, bringing live capacity at the campus to 250 MW.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 1 third HPC building
projects.quote: The third HPC building at Polaris Forge 1 (150 MW), along with Polaris Forge 2, Polaris Forge 3, Delta Forge 1, and Delta Forge 2, are in various stages of construction.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 2
projects.quote: The Company expects initial operations at Polaris Forge 2 in Harwood to increase delivered critical IT load across our North Dakota campuses to 300 MW by the end of calendar 2026, further demonstrating the Company's ability to execute against its development pipeline.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 3
projects.quote: The third HPC building at Polaris Forge 1 (150 MW), along with Polaris Forge 2, Polaris Forge 3, Delta Forge 1, and Delta Forge 2, are in various stages of construction.

projects.name: Delta Forge 1
projects.quote: The third HPC building at Polaris Forge 1 (150 MW), along with Polaris Forge 2, Polaris Forge 3, Delta Forge 1, and Delta Forge 2, are in various stages of construction.

projects.name: ChronoScale Microsoft 50 MW AI compute deployment
projects.quote: During the quarter, ChronoScale announced plans with Microsoft for a 50 MW AI compute deployment in North America featuring NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems and advanced liquid cooling.

projects.name: Finland power capacity agreement
projects.quote: The Company also took its first step outside the United States, signing an agreement for up to approximately 1 GW of potential power capacity in Finland.

projects.name: Base Electron Power Purchase Agreement
projects.quote: Entered into a Power Purchase Agreement with Base Electron, for the purchase of capacity and energy from an approximately 1,200 MW natural gas-fired generation facility to be developed by Base Electron in North Dakota.
